name: braintrust
summary: I installed the Braintrust SDK, OpenAI, and autoevals successfully via pip, and wrote the movie-matcher eval script exactly as the quickstart specifies. However, when I ran the script it failed with a `ConnectionResetError` during the TLS handshake to `api.braintrust.dev`. I confirmed the sandbox itself blocks outbound HTTPS: `curl` to `https://www.braintrust.dev`, `https://www.google.com`, and even `https://1.1.1.1` all return "Connection reset by peer," while `http://httpbin.org/get` explicitly returns "Internet is restricted on Tier 1 and Tier 2." Because the sandbox cannot reach Braintrust's API, the eval run could not be executed and no scores were reported.

installed.evidence: `pip install braintrust openai autoevals` exited 0 and downloaded `braintrust-0.41.0-py3-none-any.whl`

configured.evidence: Quickstart instructs `export OPENAI_API_KEY` but `env | grep -i openai` returned empty output

first_call.evidence: `python3 movie_matcher.py` exited 1 with urllib3 `Connection reset by peer` traceback

verified.evidence: Script failed with `exit=1`; no eval scores were produced or reported

friction.detail: `curl -s http://httpbin.org/get` returned `Internet is restricted on Tier 1 and Tier 2.`
Docs instruct `export OPENAI_API_KEY=" " # or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, etc.` but environment had none
`fetch_url` for `/docs/start/quickstart.md` returned `The requested page could not be found.`
The `run-in-code` page shows cut-off command `pnpm add braintrus`
Agent initially wrote `braintrust.login().api_key` but SDK help shows `login(...) -> None`
